name: @waste/process
description: What the API, the worker and the Pilot's supervisor agree on as processes, with no dependency at all: the ports they listen on and the transaction pooler's a database URL may not name (`src/ports.ts`), the shutdown budget the supervisor's kill is the sum of (`src/shutdown.ts`), set-but-empty counting as unset (`src/environment.ts`), and the bound every readiness probe answers within (`src/readiness.ts`). Dependency-free so that whatever reads it carries nothing more: @waste/db (the migrator's refusal, the pools' end, the database probe), the supervisor's 10 KiB bundle, and @waste/server, the two servers' kit. Server-only: apps/web is fenced out in eslint.config.mjs. Ships TypeScript source for tsx consumers.
